newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan raises fuel oil bunker prices by $2/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan raises fuel oil bunker prices by $2/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has increased its spot and term prices of bunker fuel by $2 per tonne effective November 16, a company statement said on Wednesday.

Posted prices for 180, 280 and 380-centistoke bunker fuel delivered at the ports of Keelung, Hualien, Taichung and Suao were increased by $2.00 per tonne, to $140. Term prices were similarly raised by $2.00 to $137 per tonne.
Spot and term bunker C grade was also raised by $2.00, to $138 and $135 respectively.
CPC is Taiwan's sole supplier of bunker fuels.
